searches.reason: Evolve descriptive margins into component-level failure localization. Research matched interventions on recurrent, isolated and recent history events, with fixed candidates and exclusion sets; compare rank changes against count- and position-matched random controls. Probe the residual only when the actual trained model exposes it. This could reveal whether lexical corroboration helps sustained interests or suppresses emerging ones, without treating perturbations as causal evidence about user intent.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into an auditable evidence protocol for the twenty simulator users. Seek methods linking selection and rejection reasons to exact title/description spans, distinguishing explicit specification conflicts from insufficient information. Measure annotation agreement and selected-versus-rejected rank inversions. Ownership, unmet needs, compatibility and simulator traits must remain unknown unless directly supported; the small sample supports case analysis rather than population estimates.

searches.reason: Validate whether the diagnostic toolkit detects meaningful failures before using its outputs to guide training. Research mutation testing with deliberately disabled branches, shuffled text, corrupted masks and export mismatches; check invariance under positive score rescaling and sensitivity to negative sampling. Use training-prefix audits as auxiliary measurements, and compare diagnostics with host-exposed validation outcomes across all four datasets only within the shared budget. This targets trustworthy diagnostics rather than larger training margins or embedding alignment presented as quality.
